Container.Name: yarg-song-server
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted song server for YARG. Serves a song library over HTTP as ordinary .sng packages that an unmodified YARG client can already read, with a browse page for searching and checking the library without launching the game.
READ-ONLY AND UNAUTHENTICATED BY DESIGN. Do not put this behind SWAG and do not expose it to the internet. It is meant for a LAN.
The song library is mounted READ-ONLY on purpose - the server never writes there. Point it at your own library; it will index what it finds on start.
The image is distroless (about 10 MB) and contains no shell, so the Console button will not work. That is correct behaviour, not a fault - use the WebUI, /healthz, or the container log instead.
:latest means THE NEWEST RELEASE, deliberately behind the main branch. If it looks old, cut a tag - do not repoint it at a branch. For a deployment that must not move at all, replace the tag with a @sha256: digest, which is what this container ran before this template existed.

Config.Name: WebUI / API port
Config.Description: Host port for the browse page and the HTTP API. LAN only.

Config.Name: Song library
Config.Description: Your song library, mounted READ-ONLY - the server never writes here. Loose folders and .sng both work.

Config.Name: Server data
Config.Description: Catalog and packed-archive cache. MUST be owned by 65532:65532 - the image runs as nonroot, and getting this wrong starts fine and then fails the first time a song needs packing. On the host: chown -R 65532:65532 <this path>
